learningGoals: Recognize the Indian national flag and identify its three colors and the wheel. 🧡🤍💚
Understand the concept of a country and feeling proud of being Indian. 🌍
Learn vocabulary related to unity, diversity, and national identity. 🤝
Practice using pronouns like 'we', 'our', and 'us' in sentences. 🗣️
Express respect for different people, languages, and festivals in India. 🎉
conversationStarters: What do you think the colors on our national flag mean? 🎨
What is your favorite festival that we celebrate together with family and friends? 🎉
How many languages have you heard people speak around you? 🗣️
teachingTips: Look at a map of India together and point out where you live. 🗺️
Explain the significance of the Ashoka Chakra (the blue wheel in the center of the flag). ☸️
Discuss how people in India might eat different food or wear different clothes, but we are all one family. 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
Sing the national anthem or a patriotic song together to build a sense of pride. 🎶
Encourage your child to trace or draw the map of India and color it. 🖍️

funActivities.title: Tricolor Craft 🎨
funActivities.description: Make an Indian flag using orange, white, and green paper tearing, finger painting, or clay. Draw the blue wheel in the middle!

funActivities.title: Saying 'Hello' in Many Ways 🙏
funActivities.description: Learn how to say 'Hello' or greet someone in 3-4 different Indian languages (e.g., Namaste, Vanakkam, Sat Sri Akal, Nomoshkar).

funActivities.title: Unity Collage 🖼️
funActivities.description: Cut out pictures from old magazines showing different Indian foods, clothes, and festivals. Glue them on a paper to make an 'Incredible India' collage.
